from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
b = lambda n: ((n // 10) << 4) | (n % 10)
d = lambda x: (x >> 4) * 10 + (x & 0x0F)
i2c.writeto_mem(0x68, 0x00, bytes([b(58), b(59), b(23), 4, b(31), b(12), b(26)]))
while True:
    r = i2c.readfrom_mem(0x68, 0x00, 7)
    print('20%02d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d' % (d(r[6]), d(r[5] & 0x1F), d(r[4]), d(r[2] & 0x3F), d(r[1]), d(r[0] & 0x7F)))
    t = i2c.readfrom_mem(0x68, 0x11, 2)
    print('TEMP=%.2f' % ((t[0] if t[0] < 128 else t[0] - 256) + (t[1] >> 6) * 0.25))
    time.sleep(1)
